Witty expressive secondary-school textbook humour. Match the reference character proportions, line quality and simple line anatomy. No giant-headed human children, no chibi human students, no watercolour, no coloured-pencil haze, no soft glow, no gradients, no realistic light, no elaborate rendering. Keep faces and limbs very simple. The images are style inputs only; create a new scene. Genuine transparent background. No text, no letters, no numbers, no symbols, no speech bubbles, no border, no paper/ruling/background. Compact art to remain readable when printed 28–45 mm wide and 22–30 mm high. Characters should occupy most of the canvas with a very small transparent margin.
Scene A: two bean-shaped concept characters stand back to back in the centre. One coral-red, one light cyan-blue. Their white gloved hands point outward in opposite directions toward two small plain doorframes at the left and right edges. Knowing, slightly argumentative expressions, raised eyebrows and sideways glances. The doors have no labels. Only these two characters and simple small doors. Wide compact composition, low detail.
